Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and multi-environment options. Procurement asked me to share an initial mutual action plan (attached) and a few sequencing questions so we can line up MSA/DPA/order-form signoff with our rollout windows. Top asks from our side:

Priya —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear asks. I looped in Karthik (legal) and Grace (onboarding). Quick read-through notes below; I’ll follow up with a marked-up MAP and a proposed sequencing timeline:

- 45-day signature window: realistic if we run a parallel path (Redwood legal + HelioMed legal) and agree on redline freeze slices (MSA core, DPA negotiables, order form pricing). We typically see 30–60 days for enterprise but can commit to target 45 with active MPMs and weekly legal touchpoints.
- DPA clauses: Karthik — see Priya's note. We should produce a matrix that flags negotiable items and required security attestations.
- Order form referencing model profiles: this is fine; we'll add a clause that order form "exhibits" list model configurations and that billing will follow listed profiles. We should avoid overly prescriptive language that blocks minor model substitutions for performance reasons.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Week 0–1: Redwood sends marked MAP + legal matrix
2) Week 1–3: Parallel redline window (MSA & DPA) + order-form pricing alignment
3) Week 3–5: Final agreement and DocuSign routing
4) Week 5–6: Post-signature onboarding runbook kick-off

Can your procurement/legal owners do a Tue 6/9 10:00am PT touchpoint? If yes I’ll send calendar invite and a shared Drive link with the draft matrix.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Manager, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Dylan / Priya —

I reviewed the HelioMed MAP and the preliminary order-form language. A few concrete asks from Redwood legal to make sequencing predictable:

1) Designate a single HelioMed legal point of contact for routing redlines; multiple reviewers create rework loops.
2) For data residency: we can offer region-specific hosting options (us-east/us-west/eu) but need to lock residency in the DPA exhibit before order-form execution.
3) Subcontractor disclosure: HelioMed should accept our standard subcontractor list; if they require SOC 2 evidence for a new sub, we will provide attestations but it may add ~10 business days.
4) Material deviations from our standard MSA (e.g., indemnity caps, IP carveouts) will require exec escalation and may affect the 45-day target. Please flag any such clauses early.

I’ll upload a redline tracker to the shared Drive and mark items into three buckets: quick (no exec), moderate (legal-only), executive (needs CRO/CFO/GC).

Karthik
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
